aggregate.sql:
SELECT "d"."c02" AS "d_city", SUM(t.c04) AS "value"
FROM "t"
  JOIN "d" ON "t"."c03" = "d"."c01"
WHERE ("t"."c02" >= ?) AND ("t"."c02" < ?) AND ("d"."c02" = ?)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "d_city" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

ratio.sql:
WITH grain AS (
  SELECT "d"."c02" AS "d_city", "t"."c01" AS "_key", MAX(CASE WHEN t.c04 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "_num", 1 AS "_den"
  FROM "t"
    JOIN "d" ON "t"."c03" = "d"."c01"
  
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT "d_city", SUM("_num") AS "numerator", SUM("_den") AS "denominator", SUM("_num") / NULLIF(SUM("_den"), 0) AS "value", SUM("_den") AS "order_count"
FROM grain
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "d_city" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

per_group.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT "d"."c02" AS "d_city", "d"."c01" AS "d_flag", SUM(t.c04) AS "value"
FROM "t"
  JOIN "d" ON "t"."c03" = "d"."c01"
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "value" DESC NULLS LAST, "d_city" ASC NULLS LAST, "d_flag" ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "_per_group"
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d_city" ORDER BY "value" DESC) <= 1
ORDER BY "value" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

compare.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT "d"."c02" AS "d_city", CASE WHEN "t"."c02" >= ? THEN 'current' WHEN "t"."c02" >= ? THEN 'baseline' END AS "_period", SUM(t.c04) AS "_v"
  FROM "t"
    JOIN "d" ON "t"."c03" = "d"."c01"
  WHERE ("t"."c02" >= ?) AND ("t"."c02" < ?)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT "d_city", MAX(CASE WHEN "_period" = 'current' THEN "_v" END) AS "current", MAX(CASE WHEN "_period" = 'baseline' THEN "_v" END) AS "baseline"
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  "d_city", "current", "baseline", "current" - "baseline" AS "delta", CASE WHEN "baseline" IS NULL OR "baseline" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ("current" - "baseline") / "baseline" END AS "growth_rate"
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY "d_city" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

share.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT "d"."c02" AS "d_city", SUM(t.c04) AS "value"
  FROM "t"
  JOIN "d" ON "t"."c03" = "d"."c01"
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT "d_city", "value", "value" / NULLIF(SUM("value") OVER (), 0) AS "share"
FROM grouped
ORDER BY "d_city" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100
